scope: Public Community Edition v0.5.0 and the five selected historical snapshots P001, P005, P017, P024-r1 and P069/P069_delivery
decision_note: The audit found no concrete bundled third-party CAD, BIM, scan, point-cloud, commercial model, raster texture, packed image, external font or linked Blender library. Lack of project-specific university or architect authorization is recorded, but is not treated as a blanket blocker for independently authored geometry.

source_field_observations.interpretation: These counts are overlapping source-field observations, not separate ownership claims. A single authored feature can be informed by OSM and one or more reference-only sources.

ORIGINAL_ZHSTUDIO.material: Script-authored procedural geometry, materials, arrangement, documentation and visual interpretation.
ORIGINAL_ZHSTUDIO.boundary: Does not claim ownership of real-world buildings, geographic facts, school names or trademarks.

PUBLIC_DATA_WITH_ATTRIBUTION.material: OSM source elements, mapped features and derived spatial mesh/data layers.
PUBLIC_DATA_WITH_ATTRIBUTION.boundary: ODbL obligations and rights remain effective after extraction, conversion and inclusion in the model.

REFERENCE_ONLY.material: UTS, architect, consultant, operator, government and public street imagery, photos, plans and diagrams used for visual reference.
REFERENCE_ONLY.boundary: Original reference files are not distributed and no licence to them is granted.

REDISTRIBUTABLE_THIRD_PARTY.boundary: Future direct third-party assets require a recorded redistribution licence before inclusion.

RESTRICTED_OR_UNCLEAR.material: 714 historical provenance records lack a source-field value; this is a metadata gap, not evidence that those records contain third-party binaries.
RESTRICTED_OR_UNCLEAR.treatment: Keep the gap visible, improve provenance for future edits, and withhold or replace a specific asset if a concrete restricted source is identified. Do not convert this metadata gap into a blanket project block.

jurisdiction_rule.australia: Use this same source-based framework for UTS, USYD and UNSW.
jurisdiction_rule.other_jurisdictions: Assess separately under the applicable local law and actual source record; NTU Singapore is not automatically covered by this conclusion.

limitations: This is an evidence-based project audit, not a legal opinion or universal clearance certificate.
The source-field counts cover retained provenance records and do not prove sole authorship or resolve underlying architectural design rights.
School, architect, operator and trademark rights remain reserved to their respective holders.
